{{Stub}}
Infested Blocks are a category of blocks created by [[Beckon (Disambiguation)|Beckons]].

Infested Blocks have a stage which they inherit from the last Beckon that created them. Beyond a certain stage Infested Blocks will start spawning [[Stage I Beckon|Stage I Beckons]] on top of them if they are not within range of another Beckon. Stage 3 Infested Blocks will emit particles when a Beckon is nearby. Stage 3 Infested Blocks will rarely spawn [[Sentry|Sentries]] and [[Kyphosis]] when targets are nearby.

Killing a [[Stage I Beckon]], using a [[Quench]], or placing a [[Biome Purifier]] nearby will trigger a Chain Reaction that permeates through all connected Infested Blocks, causing all infested blocks to "degrade," leaving [[Residue]] above them and converting the block into a non-infested equivalent.
